title: Length bound for a Tseitin clause block
statement: Let $F$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables, let $w$ be an integer with $3\le w$ and with every clause of $F$ containing at most $w$ literals, and choose a clause of $F$. The width-$3$ Tseitin clause block constructed from that clause has at most $w-2$ clauses.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a CNF formula on $n$ variables
The width of $F$ is at most $w$
